title: refactor(app-shell): the validation rule editor picks with the shared Select (objectui#11865)
body:
Part of #11865

Clause-②: no

The validation rule editor in Studio (`ObjectValidationsPanel`) now picks a rule's type, field, built-in format and severity with the shared Radix `Select`, the control the condition builder in the same editor already picks with. This is the validation editor's part of objectui#11865 only. *Explain access* (`AccessExplainPanel`) stays with the card for a later claim, after objectui#11862, so the card stays open.

Run by the os-dev agent for seat `domain:ui#2`, claim comment 6060773004, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01MgfduSkFrfM3eorB3UGfAU`.

## What changed

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectValidationsPanel.tsx`: one local `RulePicker`, built from `Select`, `SelectTrigger`, `SelectValue`, `SelectContent` and `SelectItem` of `@object-ui/components`, replaces the four native select elements:
  - the Type picker;
  - the field picker that the state machine, format and JSON schema editors share;
  - the Built-in format picker;
  - the Severity picker.
- Each trigger carries a test id (`rule-type`, `rule-field`, `rule-format`, `rule-severity`) and stays inside the label element that names it.
- Each picker calls the same handler expression the native `onChange` called. The *New* menu and presets, the *Runs on* row, `FieldOpt` and every write path are unchanged.
- `ObjectValidationsPanel`'s props and the package exports are unchanged. `packages/components/src/ui/**` and `packages/i18n/**` are untouched, and the panel reads the same 50 i18n keys as on the base (key set diffed).
- New suite `ObjectValidationsPanel.sharedSelect-11865.test.tsx`, 26 tests.
- Four existing suites beside the panel drove the native selects. They now pick through the primitive, and their assertions are unchanged:
  - `ObjectValidationsPanel.test.tsx`: the type-switch test;
  - `ObjectValidationsPanel.newRuleWaits-11820.test.tsx`: the existing-rule type-switch control;
  - `ObjectValidationsPanel.whenKey.test.tsx`: the guard carried across a type switch;
  - `ObjectValidationsPanel.readOnlyLook-11781.test.tsx`: its control set now counts the picker triggers, so that read-only pin still covers them.
- Patch changeset `.changeset/11865-validation-editor-shared-select.md` for `@object-ui/app-shell`.

## Select, not Combobox

- Type (6 options), Built-in format (5) and Severity (3) are short fixed lists.
- The field picker lists the object's fields. The condition builder in the same editor picks its subject from those same fields with the shared `Select` (`ConditionBuilder` imports it from `@object-ui/components`). `Select` therefore makes the editor's two field pickers alike. Triage named no numeric threshold.
- `Combobox` would change a write. Its `onSelect` passes an empty string when the current option is picked again (`currentValue === value ? "" : currentValue`). Re-picking the field a rule holds would then write `field: ""`, where the native control wrote nothing.
- `NativeSelect` is not used.

## Value written (dispatch H1): held

- **Every option of every picker is pinned.** The suite compares the `onPatch` payload as JSON text, key order included. It also names the keys of the written rule that hold `undefined`, because JSON text drops them.
  - Covered: all 6 types, the 4 field options, the 5 formats and the 3 severities on a format rule, and one field pick each on a state machine rule and a JSON schema rule.
  - Each literal was read on the base panel (`0c9fb8ea3`) by a `change` event on its native control. The read used a scratch probe, not committed, and was taken twice with identical output.
- **The empty options.** "Pick a field" still writes `field: ""`. The format's "none" still writes `format` as a key holding `undefined`. `SelectItem` refuses `value=""`, so items carry their option's index rather than its value. An index cannot collide with a field name, as a stand-in string such as `__none__` could: the spec's `ObjectSchema` accepts a field keyed `__none__` (measured).
- **Re-picking the current option writes nothing** (pinned for each picker). On the native control in a browser, picking the selected option fires no `change`. The primitive calls no `onValueChange` for the current value. Caveat: the base probe's `fireEvent.change` forces a change event even for the current option, so the base reading for those four rows is not a browser reading. The rows pin the primitive's own behaviour.

## Read-only (dispatch H2): held

- With `disabled` (a read-only package), each of the four triggers is disabled.
- Each wears every `disabled:` utility that `SelectTrigger` itself carries. The suite reads that set off a disabled `SelectTrigger`; it is not a copy.
- None opens from the keyboard, and nothing is written. A writable control pin shows the same triggers enabled.
- The panel's own `DISABLED_LOOK` is no longer put on the pickers, because the primitive carries the look.

## A stored value outside the options (dispatch H3): held

- A rule whose `field` names a field the object does not have now shows that field in the trigger. It is also listed first in the dropdown, and picking it writes nothing. Pinned.
- A severity the editor does not offer is shown too. Pinned.
- On the base, the native controls showed their first option instead (probe reading): `field: "ghost"` showed "— pick a field —", a format `uuid` showed "— none —", and severity `critical` showed "error (rejects the save)".
- Reachable: a format, state machine or JSON schema rule keeps its `field` when that field is deleted from the object draft.

## First-load bytes (dispatch H4)

- `ObjectValidationsPanel` is reached only through `StudioDesignSurface`. The console loads that lazily through `./studioBuilder` (objectui#11798), so the changed module is in the Studio chunk, not the eager closure.
- `@object-ui/components` is untouched, and `ui/select` is already eager.
- Not measured locally (no console build was run on this tree). The budget bot's reading on this PR goes in the dev report after CI.

## Accessible names

- The native controls were named by their wrapping label elements: Type, Field, Built-in format, Severity (probe reading on the base).
- The triggers stay inside the same label elements and compute the same names. Pinned with `getByRole('combobox', { name })` for all four.

## Reverse verification

Run with the implementation committed (`e3c881476`). `ObjectValidationsPanel.tsx` was replaced by its base blob `5c798884`. The replacement was proven on disk: 4 native select elements, 0 `RulePicker`, `git hash-object` equal to the base blob. The suites were then run, and the file was restored with `git checkout HEAD --` under a trap.

- The new suite on the base panel: `Tests 26 failed (26)`. This is the direction its header states: every pin reads the pickers by the test ids the primitive's triggers carry.
- The four updated suites on the base panel: `Tests 3 failed | 31 passed (34)`. The three red tests are the three type-switch tests, which now pick through the trigger. `readOnlyLook-11781` stays green there, because it still counts native select elements too.
- Restore proven: `hash-object` `abe9ebfd` equal to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` 0 bytes, `git status` clean apart from the scratch probe, which was then deleted.

## Gates (HEAD `bacd6893d`)

- Repo-root `pnpm exec vitest run` over every `ObjectValidationsPanel*` suite (9, the new one included), plus the two `ConditionBuilder` suites that mount the panel (`contextSubjects`, `mountScope`), plus `packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/column-identity.ratchet.test.ts`: `Test Files 12 passed (12)`, `Tests 121 passed (121)`. The new suite alone with the verbose reporter: `Tests 26 passed (26)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (echoed `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0. It ran after building the `@object-ui/app-shell^...` closure (29 projects, lock verdict command-exit 0). `--listFilesOnly` shows the panel in the main program and all 9 panel suites in the test program.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the 6 touched files: exit 0. `--format json`: 6 files, 0 errors, 1 warning. The warning is `react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` in the untouched `JsonField` effect, and it is also reported on the base file (eslint over the base blob).
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: "6 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)". `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`: no `major`.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`. `pnpm check:control-bytes`: OK.
- Derived from the diff, all exit 0: `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-overwrite` ("No pre-existing changeset was modified or deleted."), `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-dead-keys` (report-only; it lists no key this diff stopped reading), `check:metadata-write-doors`.
- Declared to CI: the full `@object-ui/app-shell` suite (1186 test files) and the repo-wide `pnpm lint`. The local runs above are the panel's suites and its mounting suites.

## Docs

No sentence in `content/docs` or a package README describes the validation rule editor's controls (`git grep`). There is nothing to patch under the docs-driven rule.

## Acceptance notes

- The Combobox reading above (an empty-string write on re-pick) applies to every `Combobox` caller. Whether any caller writes that empty string into metadata was not measured. Read-only inference, not filed.
